title: 'Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of nonco 's Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ( Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ) manga revealed additional cast, new staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and the first promotional video for the second season , subtitled Easy , on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Josemaru Short Anime's 3rd Teaser Reveals More Cast, January 10 Debut
content: The staff for the television short anime of creator Inochi-ya's Josemaru character revealed on Tuesday the anime's third teaser promotional video, key visual, three additional cast members, and January 10 premiere. In the video, the title character J osemaru introduces the cast of characters.
author: ANN

title: Sonic the Hedgehog, McLaren Racing Collaborates on 3-Episode Animated Special
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) of the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise started streaming a teaser trailer for a new three-episode animated special titled Sonic the Hedgehog x McLaren Racing: Beyond Fast , on Monday.
author: ANN

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure Anime Unveils Main Trailer, January 9 Premiere, Additional Cast, Theme Songs
content: The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure anime TV anime unveiled a main trailer and is officially set to begin broadcasting on January 9, 2027, on TOKYO MX, BS Asahi, AT-X and other channels. Crunchyroll will stream the series and the simulcast schedule will be announced on a later date.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast, Theme Songs, January 9 Debut
content: The staff for the television anime of Hifumi's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) novels streamed the main promotional video for the anime on Tuesday. The video announces another cast member and the January 9 premiere date for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Twisted Sisters Series Reveals More Cast, January 10 Debut
content: NHK announced eight more cast members and the January 10 premiere date for the live-action series for Kazumi Yamashita 's Twisted Sisters manga on Tuesday. title: Live-Action My Sister's Boyfriend Film's New Video Highlights Song by timelesz
content: The official website for My Sister's Boyfriend , the live-action film of Amu Meguro 's Midori Loves My Sister ( Onē-chan no Midori-kun or literally My sister's Midori-kun ) manga, presented a new special video for the film on Tuesday.

title: Tetsuya Tsutsui Launches New Ortrans Manga
content: This year's 50th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine announced on November 12 that Tetsuya Tsutsui will launch a new series titled Ortrans in next year's eighth issue on January 21. The story revolves around a series of disappearances of children from a juvenile training school.
